method.allActionFrames: Both 49-frame bodies displayed at 180px CSS-equivalent size on dark backgrounds in fixed-canvas sheets.
method.largeView: Selected motion and entry/exit frames at 320px CSS-equivalent size on both pale and dark backgrounds.
method.bridge: All nine entry and nine exit states compared at native 480 frame coordinates in face and clothing crops; complete bridge sheets also inspected.
method.sizeEvidence: assistant-panel.module.css defines desktop floating 180px, mobile floating 128px, companion 160/120px and panel max 320px.
method.limits: Static neighboring-frame inspection, not actual browser runtime playback or screen-recorded temporal validation. Source implementation metrics are not treated as acceptance proof.

bow.result: Local hand repair maintains natural-source texture. At inspected application sizes the bow reads coherently with stable character identity, clothing and attached hands. No obvious new missing limb or major hand-shape jump found.
acceptableLowResolutionLimits: Small resting finger separations remain soft.
Hair-edge antialiasing remains slightly rough on a dark background under close inspection.

thinking.result: F039-F041 colour decontamination is conservative and does not introduce a changed palm direction or separate wrist. At 180px the remaining finger softness does not dominate the motion; at 320px fine edge softness is still visible but no new gross anatomy discontinuity was observed.
acceptableLowResolutionLimits: F039-F041 finger topology is not newly reconstructed and remains low-detail.
Minor soft source-video textures remain in hands and moving sleeves.

observations: No obvious doubled eye, jacket stripe or duplicate character outline observed in inspected entry/exit states.
Face, hair and clothing shift primarily in sharpness/fine detail; the interpolation distributes that residual difference over the transition rather than restoring identical source pixels.
No visually obvious identity replacement or 2D-to-3D change found at the actual assistant display sizes in these sheets.
bridgeFindings.doNotMisrepresent: Do not describe this as a proof of anatomical flow or full style consistency. Small flow magnitude and exact endpoint hashes alone do not establish a good animated transition.
runtimeCheckStillRequired: Play the actual idle -> bow/thinking -> idle route at native timing on both backgrounds.
Verify that the 320ms sharpness transition does not read as a colour pulse, ghosting or a conspicuous pause.
Verify arbitrary idle-phase trigger behavior, interruption/retrigger behavior and final return to idle in the real renderer.

recommendation: Proceed to runtime/browser visual acceptance using current candidate files. Current static findings do not justify further whole-character redraw or broad destructive edge filtering, but also do not independently authorize a deployment PASS.
